z-m-05-05.title: Pane marubles mangani paboard yemarubles?
z-m-05-05.goal: Enzanisa nzira nhatu dzekuverenga, sarudza kuti nzira ipi yakarurama pasi pemamiriro api, uye unyore kuti nei tichiongorora mhinduro nenzira yakasiyana.
z-m-05-05.material:
Board yemarubles ine mitsara 5 yemakomba, ine makomba 6 mumutsara mumwe nemumwe (makomba 30 pamwe chete). Asi marubles haapo mukomba rega rega, uye pane makomba 3 asina chinhu. Nhamba dzemarubles mumitsara 1 kusvika 5, nenzira, i6, 6, 5, 5, 5. Shamwari nhatu dzakawana nhamba yemarubles.
Gaon: "5×6=30, saka pane marubles 30."
Narae: "Pane makomba 30 uye makomba 3 asina chinhu, saka 30 kubvisa 3 i27 marubles."
Daon: "Ndakaverenga marubles mumutsara wega wega ndikawedzera. 6+6+5+5+5=27 marubles."
z-m-05-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose dzinotaura kuti pane marubles mangani pamwe chete.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kana pane makomba 3 asina chinhu, fungidzira kana nhamba yemarubles iri huru kana diki kupfuura nhamba yemakomba.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.1: Wana musiyano pakati pehuwandu hwemarubles mumutsara wega wega nenhamba yemakomba, 30, uye uuenzanise nenhamba yemakomba asina chinhu.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.a: Iyi inzira yekuverenga marubles mumutsara wega wega zvakananga uye kuwedzera.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.b: 5×6 inhamba yemakomba. Inoenzana nenhamba yemarubles chete kana komba rega rega rine rubble imwe. Board iyi ine makomba asina chinhu.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.c: Iyi inzira yekubvisa nhamba yemakomba asina chinhu kubva panhamba yemakomba kuwana nhamba yemarubles.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.explain: Narae akabvisa makomba 3 asina chinhu kubva pamakomba 30 ndokuwana 27, uye Daon akaverenga mutsara nemutsara ndokuwedzera kuwana 27. 30 yaGaon kukosha kunofungidzira kuti pane rubble mukomba rega rega.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.prompt: Chii chaunofanira kuongorora kutanga kuti uwane nhamba yemarubles nenzira yaGaon?
z-m-05-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mumutsara mumwe kuti 5×6 inoverenga chii.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dhirowa mutsara mumwe weboard yemarubles uye utarise kuti komba rimwe nerubble rimwe zvakabatanidzwa sei.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.a: Kana marubles ose ari ruvara rumwe chete
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.b: Chero chimiro chiri chei, nhamba yemarubles inoenderana nekuti komba rega rega rine rubble here.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.c: Mutsara upi une marubles akawanda zvikuru
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.c: Kuti mitsara ine nhamba imwe chete kana nhamba dzakasiyana kunokanganisa kuti unoshandisa sei kuwanza, asi unofanira kutanga watarisa kana pane makomba asina chinhu.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.d: Kana komba rega rega rine rubble imwe
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.d: Mugumisiro inhamba yemakomba, saka chakakosha ndechekuti komba rega rega rine rubble here.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.explain: 5×6=30 inhamba yemakomba. Kana pane rubble imwe mukomba rega rega, pane marubles 30 futi. Kana pane makomba asina chinhu, pane mashoma ehuwandu hwakadaro.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza nzira yaNarae kana yaDaon, nyora maitiro ekuwana nhamba yemarubles nayo, uye unyorewo kuti ungaongorora sei kana mhinduro yakarurama uchishandisa nzira yeimwe shamwari.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora migumisiro yenzira mbiri padivi nedivi.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mumutsara mumwe kuti chii chinoita kuti uvimbe kana makosha maviri akafanana.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kuverenga kwenzira yawakasarudza kunoenderana nenhamba chaiyo yemarubles, 27, here?
z-m-05-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kana uchiongorora nenzira yakasiyana, wakataura here kuti unoenzanisa makosha maviri?
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.0: Nzira yaNarae inobvisa makomba 3 asina chinhu kubva pamakomba 30. Kana ukaverenga marubles mumutsara wega wega ukawedzera, sezvakaita Daon, unowanawo 27, saka vanosimbisana.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.1: Ndakawana 6+6+5+5+5=27 nenzira yaDaon. Kana ndikabvisa makomba 3 asina chinhu kubva pamakomba 30, i27, saka ndinogona kuongorora kuti kukosha kumwe chete kunobuda.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.2: Nzira yaDaon: 6+6+5+5+5=27. Nenzira yaNarae 30-3=27, inofanana, saka mhinduro yakarurama.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.3: Narae: makomba 30 kubvisa makomba 3 asina chinhu i27. Kuverenga mutsara wega wega nekuwedzera sezvakaita Daon kunopawo 27, saka vanobvumirana.

z-m-05-06.title: Kuwanza kunogara kuchiita kuti nhamba ive huru kupfuura pakutanga here?
z-m-05-06.goal: Edza chirevo che 'kuwanza kunoita kuti nhamba ive huru kupfuura yekutanga' nemacounterexamples, uye utaure kuti kunoshanda kuvawanzi vapi.
z-m-05-06.material: Doyun akati, "Kana ukawanza nhamba nenhamba imwe, inogara ichiva huru kupfuura nhamba yekutanga!" Pano nhamba yekutanga a inhamba kubva pa1 kusvika pa9, uye muwanzi b inhamba kubva pa0 kusvika pa9. Wana mugumisiro uchishandisa zvakajairika zvekuwanza.
z-m-05-06.prereq.0: Ziva zvakajairika zvekuwanza nemigumisiro ne0 ne1 (giredhi 2)
z-m-05-06.s.s1.prompt: Nzira yakanaka yekuongorora chirevo chaDoyun ndeipi?
z-m-05-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga kuedza kubva apo muwanzi ari nhamba diki zvikuru.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.hint.1: Wedzera muwanzi rimwe panguva kubva pa0 uye unyore mutebhura kuti mugumisiro unochinja sei.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.a: Chinja muwanzi uye utsvage migumisiro isingakure
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.a: Iyi inzira yekuziva kuti izwi re 'nguva dzose' rinogona kuputswa nemuenzaniso mumwe chete, uye kutsvaga nyaya dzingariputsa.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.b: 3×2, 4×5, ne6×3 zvose zvakakura, saka chirevo chakarurama
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange mienzaniso yose mitatu yakakura, wakangoedza nyaya umo muwanzi i2 kana kupfuura. Edzawo vawanzi vamwe.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.c: Kuwanza kunoita kuti zvinhu zvikure, saka chakarurama pasina kuedza
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.c: Pfungwa yekuti kuwanza kunoita kuti zvinhu zvikure kufungidzira, kwete mutemo. Haugoni kuziva usati waedza.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.d: Sarudza nzvimbo dziri mutebhura yekuwanza chete umo muwanzi mukuru
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.d: Kana ukasarudza nhamba hombe chete, haugoni kuona nyaya umo chirevo chingaputsika. Tanga wafunga kuwanza nenhamba dzerudzi rupi dzingaputsa chirevo.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.explain: Kuongorora 'inogara ichikura', nzira iri nyore zvikuru kuwana nekuedza nyaya dzingasakura. Kuedza marudzi akasiyana evawanzi kunokosha kupfuura kuunganidza mienzaniso mizhinji padivi rimwe chete.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana umo chirevo chaDoyun chisiri chechokwadi. (Mugumisiro haufanire kuva mukuru kupfuura nhamba yekutanga a. Mugumisiro unoenzana nenhamba yekutanga unoverengwawo se 'husina kukura'.)
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.0: Wana ma products kana multiplier i 0 nekana i 1.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kana chinhu chimwechete chichiitika kana ukachinja nhamba yekutanga.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.2: Product yakaenzana nenhamba yekutanga inosanganisirwawo mu 'haina kukura'.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba yekutanga i nhamba kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba yekutanga inofanira kuva natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Multiplier i nhamba kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Multiplier inofanira kuva nhamba kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Product haina kukura kupfuura nhamba yekutanga.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.explain: Kana multiplier i 0, product i 0, saka inodzikira, uye kana i 1, product yakafanana nenhamba yekutanga, saka haikure. Kana multiplier i 2 kana kupfuura, product inokura kana nhamba yekutanga i 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangurira Doyun, nemienzaniso, kuti unowanza nenhamba dzipi kana chirevo chake chisiri chechokwadi.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarudza mienzaniso yako miviri uye unyore product nenhamba yekutanga padivi pedivi.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti multiplier i chii mumienzaniso miviri.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Mumienzaniso yako, wakaenzanisa product nenhamba yekutanga zvakananga here?
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa kuti mhedzisiro ye 0 neye 1 dzakasiyana here?
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukawanza ne 0, 5×0=0, saka inova diki kupfuura nhamba yekutanga. Kana ukawanza ne 1, 5×1=5, saka inoramba yakafanana. Saka chirevo che 'inogara ichikura' chakaipa.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana multiplier i 1, 7×1=7 yakafanana nenhamba yekutanga, saka haikure. Kana i 0, inova 0 uye inodzikira.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.prompt: Kana nhamba yekutanga i nhamba kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 9, multiplier inofanira kuva nhamba yakadini kuti product igare ichikura kupfuura nhamba yekutanga?
z-m-05-06.s.s3.hint.0: Wana ma products kana multiplier i 1, 2, ne 3, uye uenzanise rimwe nerimwe nenhamba yekutanga.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.hint.1: Isa nhamba yekutanga se 4 uye ushandise ma multipliers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 5 kutarisa kuti product inochinja sei.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.a: Kana ukawanza ne 1, product yakafanana nenhamba yekutanga. Kufanana hakusi 'kukura'.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.b: Nhamba dzisiri 0 dzinosanganisira 1. Tarisa zvinoitika kana ukawanza ne 1.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.c: Kana multiplier i 2 kana kupfuura, product i hombe kana yakaenzana nenhamba yekutanga pamwe nenhamba yekutanga, saka inogara ichikura.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.d: Kuwanza ne 3 kunoitawo kuti ikure. Pane dzimwe nhamba kunze kwenhamba dzakaenzana chete.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.explain: Kana multiplier i 2 kana kupfuura, product i ka2 yenhamba yekutanga zvishoma, saka kana nhamba yekutanga i 1 kana kupfuura, inogara iri hombe kupfuura nhamba yekutanga. Nhamba dzisiri dzakaenzana, sa 3, dzinosanganisirwawo.

z-m-05-01.title: Unowana nhamba yerudzi rupi kana nhamba mbiri dzeodd dzasangana?
z-m-05-01.goal: Unganidza mienzaniso kufungidzira kuti sum yemakadhi eodd inhamba yerudzi rupi, chinja kuti unovimba nekufungidzira kwako zvakadii mushure mekunzwa tsananguro yekuita mapeya, uye ushandise muenzaniso unopikisa kuratidza kuti chirevo chakadzoserwa hachishande.
z-m-05-01.material: Seoa naHajun vanotamba mutambo wemakadhi enhamba (nhamba 1 kusvika ku30). Nhamba even inhamba isina chasara kana wakaiita mapoka emapeya (2, 4, 6, ...), uye nhamba odd inhamba ine imwe yasara kana wakaiita mapoka emapeya (1, 3, 5, ...). Mumutambo uyu, 'sum' ndiko kukosha kwaunowana nekuwedzera nhamba dzose dzakanyorwa pamakadhi.
z-m-05-01.thinking.0: Gadzira kufungidzira kubva pamienzaniso mishoma uye gadzirisa kuti unovimba nako zvakadii
z-m-05-01.thinking.1: Chinja kutonga kwako mushure mekuwana mienzaniso mitsva netsananguro
z-m-05-01.thinking.2: Gadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso unopikisa kuchirevo chakadzoserwa
z-m-05-01.prereq.0: Ziva kuti nhamba even haina chasara kana yaitwa mapoka emapeya uye nhamba odd ine imwe yasara (Grade 2)
z-m-05-01.prereq.1: Kuwedzera nhamba kubva ku1 kusvika ku30
z-m-05-01.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa rumwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza pfungwa yako nezve sum yemakadhi eodd.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa sums dzemienzaniso kuita even ne odd, uye uidzironge mutafura.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa 3 ne5 semadotsi uye uvaite mapeya iwe pachako, uchitevera tsananguro yaHajun.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Seoa akawana sum yemakadhi maviri eodd katatu. Sum ye3 ne5 ndi8, sum ye7 ne9 ndi16, uye sum ye1 ne11 ndi12.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti sum yemakadhi maviri eodd ichava nhamba yerudzi rupi?
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Nemienzaniso mitatu, zvakakodzera kuenda kusvika kukufungidzira 'zvinoratidzika kuva even.' Kuti utaure 'nguva dzose,' unoda chikonzero kana kuedza kwakawanda.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Katatu zvose zvaiva even, saka tinogona kutaura kuti nguva dzose ndi even
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Mienzaniso mitatu inzira, asi haivimbisi nyaya dzose. Unogona kuedza nenhamba dzimwe.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinoratidzika kuva even. Kana ndikaedza nhamba dzimwe dzeodd, ndinogona kuvimba zvakanyanya
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakagadzira kufungidzira kubva pamienzaniso uye wakataurawo hurongwa hwekuedza kwakawanda.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Sums ndi8, 16, ne12, dzakasiyana, saka hapana mutemo wakatarwa
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kunyange saizi dzema sums dzichisiyana, rudzi rwadzo (even kana odd) runogona kuva rwakafanana. Sarudza zvakare kuti chii chinofanira kuenzaniswa.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Takawedzera nhamba mbiri dzeodd, saka sum ichavawo odd
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hauna kutarisa nemienzaniso kana rudzi rwenhamba dzinowedzerwa runova rudzi rwe sum. Tarisazve 8, 16, ne12.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Seoa akaedzawo nemakadhi matatu eodd. Sum ye3, 5, ne7 ndi15, sum ye1, 9, ne11 ndi21, uye sum ye5, 5, ne9 ndi19.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kana huwandu hwemakadhi hwachinja, unofunga kuti chii chichaitika kurudzi rwe sum?
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Nemakadhi maviri, even yakaramba ichiuya, uye nemakadhi matatu, odd yakaramba ichiuya, saka kufungidzira kuti kunoenderana nehuwandu hwemakadhi kunokodzera. Ichiri kufungidzira chete.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Chero makadhi eodd mangani, sum inogara iri even
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tarisazve sums dzemakadhi matatu: 15, 21, ne19. Dzakafanana nerudzi rwemakadhi maviri here?
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Nemakadhi matatu unowana nhamba hombe, saka sum ndi odd
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kuti nhamba ihombe kana diki kwakaparadzana nekuti ndi odd kana even. Sum 16 yemakadhi maviri yaivawo hombe kupfuura 8.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Makadhi maviri akapa even, makadhi matatu akapa odd. Zvinoratidzika kuenderana nehuwandu hwemakadhi
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakaenzanisa mienzaniso yenyaya mbiri uye wakafungidzira musiyano unoenderana nehuwandu hwemakadhi.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Pane mienzaniso mishoma chete, saka hapana chinogona kutaurwa
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kunyange nemienzaniso mishoma, unogona kutaura kuti tsika ipi yauri kuona. Kana ukati hapana chinogona kutaurwa, hapana chekuedza zvinotevera.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Hajun akatsanangura nemashoko. 'Nhamba odd inhamba ine imwe yasara kana wakaiita mapoka emapeya. Kana ukaisa mapoka maviri eodd pamwe chete, ina mbiri dzakasara dzinogona kuitwa peya nemumwe, saka hapana chinosara.'
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mushure mekuverenga tsananguro yaHajun, pfungwa yekuti 'sum yemakadhi maviri eodd ndi even' yakava inotendeseka zvakadii?
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Chikonzero chinobva pachimiro chenhamba odd, 'imwe yasara,' saka unogona kutenda kuti chinokodzera makadhi maviri eodd chero api. Nemapoka matatu, imwe pakati pematatu yasara inosara zvakare, saka sum ndi odd, uye izvi zvinosangana ne15, 21, ne19.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Haisi 3 ne5 chete. Nhamba odd chero ipi ine imwe yasara, saka zvinoratidzika kukodzera mapeya ose emakadhi eodd
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakatonga uchivimba nechimiro che 'imwe yasara,' kwete nhamba chaidzo.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Tsananguro yaHajun inoshanda ku3 ne5 chete, saka tinofanira kuedza nhamba dzimwe dzeodd
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Nhamba 3 ne5 hadziwoneki mutsananguro. Verenga zvakare kuti tsananguro inotaura nenhamba dzipi.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Hatigoni kuziva kusvika taedza nhamba dzose dzeodd imwe imwe
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Pane nhamba dzeodd dzisingaperi, saka hatigoni kuedza dzose. Kana uchiziva chikonzero, unogona kusarudza pasina kuedza imwe imwe.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Zvino zvatova netsananguro, hapana chikonzero chekuedza mienzaniso yakawanda
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Unogona zvakare kuedza kana tsananguro yakarurama nemienzaniso mitsva senge nhamba hombe (semuenzaniso, 99 ne101).
z-m-05-01.s.s1.reflect: Kufungidzira kwako kwekutanga kwakasiyana sei nepfungwa yako yekupedzisira? Taura kuti shanduko ipi yakabva pakuva nemienzaniso yakawanda neipi yakabva pakudzidza chikonzero.
z-m-05-01.s.s2.prompt: Seoa akati, 'Kana sum yenhamba mbiri iri even, nhamba mbiri dzose ndema even.' Gadzira mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana umo izvi zvisiri zvechokwadi. (Nhamba mbiri ndema natural numbers kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.)
z-m-05-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wafunga nhamba mbiri dzine sum even, wozobvisa nyaya apo nhamba mbiri dzose ndema even.

z-m-05-01.s.s2.hint.2: Mienzaniso inongotsiva kurongeka (3 ne5, 5 ne3) inoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.

z-m-05-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba mbiri dzinofanira kuva natural numbers kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
z-m-05-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Imwe yenhamba mbiri ndi odd, saka izvi hazvikodzeri chirevo chaSeoa.
z-m-05-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Nhamba mbiri dzose ndema even, saka izvi hazvipokani nechirevo chaSeoa.

z-m-05-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza umwe wemienzaniso yako uye utsanangure, uchishandisa nhamba, kuti nei ichiratidza chirevo chaSeoa chisiri chechokwadi.

z-m-05-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Edza kunyora mutsara mumwe muchimiro che 'Sum ndi ..., asi nhamba ndi ...'.

Tebhura re 6: 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54

z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Jiho ane zvakawanda. Nekuti Jiho achine 100 won yakawanda
z-m-05-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatarisa musiyano wazvino we100 won chete. Enzanisa kuti munhu mumwe nemumwe anoisa zvakawanda sei vhiki rino.

z-m-05-09.s.s1.reflect: Kufungidzira kwako kwekutanga kwakasiyana sei nekutonga kwako kwekupedzisira? Taura kuti data ipi yakachinja kufunga kwako, kana kuti kwakaramba kwakadaro.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, sarudza plan yaSeoa iwe pachako. Jiho anotanga ne1000 won mu vhiki 1 uye anokura ne500 won vhiki rega rega (1500 mu vhiki 2, 2000 mu vhiki 3, 2500 won mu vhiki 4). Nyora mapeya 3 akasiyana (s, d) umo Seoa asina zvakawanda kupfuura Jiho kusvika vhiki 3 (kuenzana kunobvumirwa) uye ane zvakawanda kupfuura Jiho kekutanga mu vhiki 4. (s ne d dziri mu units dze100 won, s ndi100 kusvika ku1000 won, uye d ndi100 kusvika ku1000 won.)
z-m-05-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mari yaSeoa mumavhiki 3 ne4 semakuverenga uchishandisa s ne d.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza d kutanga, wozochinja s uye utsvage apo mamiriro ose maviri anoshanda.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.fail.c1: s ne d dzinofanira kuva mu units dze100 won uye kubva ku100 kusvika ku1000 won.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Kusvika vhiki 3, haana zvakawanda kupfuura Jiho (kuenzana kunobvumirwa).
z-m-05-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Mu vhiki 3, Seoa ane zvakawanda kupfuura Jiho.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Mu vhiki 4, ane zvakawanda kupfuura Jiho.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Mu vhiki 4, Seoa haana zvakawanda kupfuura Jiho.
z-m-05-09.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, (500, 700) inopa 1900 won mu vhiki 3 ne2600 won mu vhiki 4. (400, 700) inopa 2500 won mu vhiki 4, iyo yakaenzana, saka haisi 'yakawanda,' uye (1000, 600) iri pamberi kare mu vhiki 3 ne2200 won.

z-m-05-10.title: Matombo ayo shamwari mbiri dzose dzinotsika mukuyambuka matombo
z-m-05-10.goal: Tsvaga nhamba dzinoonekwa mukuverenga kwekusvetuka kuviri dzose nekugadzira marondedzero, sarudza nzira yekutarisa kana mutemo wakawanikwa kubva panhamba mbishoma unogona kuenderera, uye gadzira iwe pachako kuverenga kwekusvetuka kunokodzera mamiriro.
z-m-05-10.material:
Mugwasha, matombo akaiswa nenhevedzano kubva ku1 kusvika ku60. Minseo anotanga pa0 uye anosvetuka nzvimbo 3 panguva (3, 6, 9, ...), uye Yuna anotangawo pa0 uye anosvetuka nzvimbo 5 panguva (5, 10, 15, ...). Matombo aanosvika vaviri nekusvetuka anonzi 'matombo akatsikwa.' Matombo akatsikwa nemumwe nemumwe kusvika patombo 30 ndeaya anotevera.
Minseo: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27, 30
Yuna: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30
z-m-05-10.thinking.0: Enzanisa mitemo miviri uye utsvage nhamba dzakafanana
z-m-05-10.thinking.1: Sarudza kuti ungatarisa sei mutemo wawakafungidzira
z-m-05-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza matombo ose, kusvika patombo 30, aitsikwa nevaviri vose.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ratidza nhamba dzinoonekwa mumarondedzero ose maviri.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.r.a: Minseo chete ndiye akatsika tombo 6. Tarisa kana riri murondedzero yaYuna.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.r.c: Yuna chete ndiye akatsika tombo 20. Tarisa kana riri murondedzero yaMinseo.
z-m-05-10.s.s1.explain: Matombo 15 ne30 ari mumarondedzero ose maviri.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.prompt: Matombo atsikwa nevose atatowanikwa kusvika zvino ndi matombo 15 ne30. Unogona kutenda sei kuti tombo rinotevera ratsikwa nevose richava tombo 45?
z-m-05-10.s.s2.hint.0: Enderera nerondedzero yaMinseo kubva shure kwetombo 30.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.hint.1: Enderera nerondedzero yaYuna zvakare, kubva shure kwetombo 30 kusvika patombo 45, uye uenzanise.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.a: Kuona maviri, yakakura ne15, saka tombo 45 rakatarwa
z-m-05-10.s.s2.r.a: Kana ukati zvakatarwa kubva pamaviri chete, hausati watarisa kana zvingachinja zvinotevera.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.b: Maviri haatiudze chinhu uye hapana nzira yekutarisa
z-m-05-10.s.s2.r.b: Kana ukaenderera nemarondedzero kusvika patombo 45, unogona kutarisa.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.c: Enderera nemarondedzero kutarisa kana tombo 45 richionekwa mumarondedzero ose maviri
z-m-05-10.s.s2.o.d: Richava tombo 35. Nekuti Yuna anosvetuka ne5
z-m-05-10.s.s2.r.d: Tarisa murondedzero yaMinseo kuti tombo 35 ratsikwa naYuna chete here.
z-m-05-10.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaenderera nemarondedzero ose maviri kusvika patombo 45, Minseo anosvika patombo 45 (3×15) uye Yuna anosvika patombo 45 (5×9). Kana ukatarisa nemarondedzero, unogona kuvimba nekufungidzira.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, sarudza iwe pachako saizi dzekusvetuka dzeshamwari mbiri. Vose vanotanga patombo 0, uye saizi dzekusvetuka p ne q dzinhamba dzakasiyana kubva ku2 kusvika ku6 (p iri pasi pe q). Nyora mapeya 4 akasiyana (p, q) umo tombo rekutanga ratsikwa nevose riri patombo 20 kana pasi.

z-m-05-10.s.s3.hint.1: Zvakakwana kunyora marondedzero kusvika nhamba imwe chete yatanga kuoneka.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.hint.2: Nyora marondedzero kusvika patombo 20 chete uye utarise kana pane nhamba inofukidzana.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.ok.c1: Dzinobva ku2 kusvika ku6 uye p iri pasi pe q.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.fail.c1: p ne q dzinofanira kuva natural numbers kubva ku2 kusvika ku6 uye p inofanira kuva pasi pe q.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.ok.c2: Tombo rekutanga ratsikwa nevose riri patombo 20 kana pasi.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Tombo rekutanga ratsikwa nevose rakakura kupfuura tombo 20.
z-m-05-10.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, (4, 5) vanosangana kekutanga patombo 20 mu 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 ne5, 10, 15, 20. (5, 6) vanosangana kekutanga patombo 30, rakapfuura tombo 20. Pane mapeya 9 anogoneka dzose.
